items.prompt: What list does classify([(6,3),(7,3)]) return under the shown common-bit-count contract?

options.why: This tests the numeric parity of the intersections 2 and 3 instead of counting their set bits.
The second intersection is 3, which has two set bits and therefore even population count.
6 AND 3 is 2 with one set bit; 7 AND 3 is 3 with two set bits.
The first intersection has one set bit. Its even numeric value does not make its population count even.

items.explanation: 6 AND 3 is 2 with one set bit; 7 AND 3 is 3 with two set bits.
